header.name: Optical Networking
header.description:
To equip students with understanding of optical core networking systems. To study the architecture used in the networks and the different technologies used for optical core networks. Study the algorithms/schemes used for routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) and routing and spectrum allocation (RSA).
Challenging issues in optical core networks.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: The students can understand the design principles of optical networks and propose suitable schemes/approaches for different planning and operational problems.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: The students can formulate optimization problems for routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) / routing and spectrum allocation (RSA) approaches.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: The students can simulate their proposed schemes/approaches and validate the simulation results.

lecture_topics: Wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) optical networks and their limitations
Integer linear programming (ILP) formulation for routing and wavelength assignment (RWA)
Different aspects related to routing and spectrum allocation (RSA)

resources.title: Biswanath Mukherjee, Optical WDM Networks, Springer, 2006
R.Ramaswami, K.Sivarajan, G. Sasaki, Optical Networks- A Practical Perspective, 3rd Ed., Elsevier Publication, 2009.
Siva Ram Murthy, Mohan Gurusamy, WDM Optical Networks: concepts, Design, and Algorithms, Prentice–Hall, 2002
Eiji Oki, Linear Programming and Algorithms for Communication Networks, Boca Raton, FL, USA: CRC Press, 2012 Pearson.
Link to the research papers will be provided.
